name: Zscaler Web Security
description: This App is installed via automation.DO NOT DELETE since its shared.

children.name: Basic Parser with KVAuto of LEEF

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "zscaler-nss: LEEF"
| parse "|*|*|*|*|*" as Vendor,Product,Ver,Category,kvout
| kv auto field=kvout

children.name: Zscaler - Behavior
children.description: The Zscaler - Behavior Dashboard focuses on allowed traffic behaviors, showing trends and deviations by users, content types accessed, content categories, super categories, and bandwidth trends.

panels.name: Data Volume
panels.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler*

panels.name: Non-General Browsing
panels.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler*

panels.name: General Browsing
panels.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler*

panels.name: MB Out by Top 5 Countries
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "cat=Allowed" "threatname=None" 
| parse "dst=*\t" as dest_ip, "dstBytes=*\t" as dest_Bytes
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name from geo://location on dest_ip=ip
| sum(dest_Bytes) as mb by country_name 
| mb/1024/1024 as mb
| total mb as total_mb
| (mb/total_mb)*100 as percent
| format("%.2f",percent) as percent
| fields -total_mb
| sort mb
| Limit 5
| format("%.1f",mb) as mb

panels.name: Non-General Activity by App Class
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "appclass=*\t" as appclass
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, appclass
| transpose row _timeslice column appclass

panels.name: General Activity by Super Category and Sub Category
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "general browsing" "cat=Allowed"
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "urlcategory=*\t" as category
| parse "urlsupercategory=*\t" as supercategory
| count by category, supercategory
| transpose row supercategory column category

panels.name: MB In by Top 5 Countries
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "cat=Allowed" "threatname=None" 
| parse "dst=*\t" as dest_ip, "srcBytes=*\t" as src_bytes
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name from geo://location on dest_ip=ip
| sum(src_bytes) as mb by country_name 
| mb/1024/1024 as mb
| total mb as total_mb
| (mb/total_mb)*100 as percent
| format("%.2f",percent) as percent
| fields -total_mb
| sort mb
| Limit 5
| format("%.1f",mb) as mb

panels.name: Non-General Activity by App Name
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "appname=*\t" as application
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, application
| transpose row _timeslice column application

panels.name: General Browsing by Realm
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "general browsing" "cat=Allowed"
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "realm=*\t" as realm
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, realm
| transpose row _timeslice column realm

panels.name: Destination vs Source Volume
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "cat=Allowed" "threatname=None" 
| parse regex "\t(?<type>\w+)Bytes=(?<mb>\d+)" multi
| timeslice 5m
| sum(mb) as mb by _timeslice, type
| mb/1024/1024 as mb 
| transpose row _timeslice column type

panels.name: Non-General Activity Top Named Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| where src_user matches "*@*"
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, src_user
| sort by _timeslice, _count
| 1 as rownum
| accum rownum as index by _timeslice
| if(index=1, 1,0) as isFirst
| accum isFirst as rankOrder
| where index <= 10
| fields _timeslice, src_user, _count
| transpose row _timeslice column src_user

panels.name: Top General Browsing by Named Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* "general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| where src_user matches "*@*"
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, src_user
| sort by _timeslice, _count
| 1 as rownum
| accum rownum as index by _timeslice
| if(index=1, 1,0) as isFirst
| accum isFirst as rankOrder
| where index <= 10
| fields _timeslice, src_user, _count
| transpose row _timeslice column src_user

children.name: Zscaler - Blocked Traffic
children.description: The Zscaler - Blocked Traffic Dashboard illustrates outliers in both blocked traffic peaks and multi-dimensional outliers for blocked activity specific to user.

panels.name: Blocked Events Outliers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "cat=*\t" as category
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| timeslice 1m
| count by _timeslice
| outlier _count threshold=5, direction=+

panels.name: Top 10 Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| count by src_user
| top 10 src_user by _count

panels.name: Top 10 By Realm
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "realm=*\t" as realm 
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| count by realm
| top 10 realm by _count

panels.name: Outliers by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "usrName=*\t" as src_user 
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| timeslice 10m
| count by _timeslice, src_user
| outlier _count by src_user direction=+
| where _count_violation=1
| count by _timeslice, src_user
| transpose row _timeslice column src_user

panels.name: Top 10 Policy Violations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "policy=*\t" as policy 
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| count by policy
| top 10 policy by _count

panels.name: Policy Violations by Realm
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "policy=*\t" as policy, "realm=*\t" as realm
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| count by policy,realm
| transpose row realm column policy

panels.name: Top 10 Blocked Base URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"cat=Allowed" 
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "url=*\t" as url
| parse regex field=url "(?<baseurl>.+?)[:/]" nodrop
| count by baseurl
| sort _count
| top 10 baseurl by _count

children.name: Zscaler - File Classification Activity
children.description: The Zscaler - File Classification Activity Dashboard focuses on file-based threats by users, threat name, file types, and subtypes for a overarching view of blocked files across the Zscaler environment.

panels.name: File Threats By User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=none" !"threatname= "
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| timeslice 5m
| count by src_user, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column src_user

panels.name: Threats by App
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=none" !"threatname= "//ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "appname=*\t"as application | parse "threatname=*\t" as threat
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| if(isnull(application),"Unclassified",application) as application
| count by application,threat
| transpose row application column threat

panels.name: File Based Threats Outlier
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=None" !"threatname= " //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(5m)
| outlier _count

panels.name: Threats by File Class
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=none" !"threatname= "//ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| parse "fileclass=*\t"as fileclass | parse "threatname=*\t" as threat
| count by fileclass,threat
| transpose row fileclass column threat

panels.name: File Threats by Risk Score
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=none" !"threatname= " //ensure no nones and nulls
| parse "riskscore=*\t" as riskscore
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, riskscore
| transpose row _timeslice column riskscore

panels.name: Threats by File Types
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* !"filetype=None" filetype !"threatname=none" !"threatname= "
| parse "fileclass=*\t" as fileclass,"filetype=*\t" as filetype
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| count by fileclass, filetype
| transpose row fileclass column filetype

children.name: Zscaler - Overview
children.description: The Zscaler - Overview Dashboard provides general information of the Zscaler Web Security logs, including Panels that drill-down into the other Zscaler Dashboards. The Overview Dashboard gives a good starting point for detecting anomalies in blocked traffic and geographic hotspots for allowed and blocked traffic.

panels.queryString:

panels.name: Location of Allowed Activities

panels.name: Denied to Allowed Ratio
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zscaler* 
| parse "cat=*\t" as category
| parse "src=*\t" as src_ip, "usrName=*\t" as src_user
| if(category="Allowed",1,0) as allowed | if(allowed=1,0,1) as denied
| timeslice 5m
| count,sum(allowed) as allowed, sum(denied) as denied by _timeslice
| (denied/allowed)*100 as ratio 
| fields _timeslice,ratio

| outlier ratio
